head: ac04c7ad
subject: Literal RDS path_rewrite and host_rewrite
change: RouteAction path_rewrite (field 45) and host_rewrite (field 44) are now decoded as literal rewrites when they contain no substitution format specifier. Empty path_rewrite/host_rewrite values preserve the original path/authority, matching Envoy's empty-output rule. Values containing '%' still fail validation because format substitution is not implemented. These fields join prefix_rewrite, host_rewrite_literal and host_rewrite_header in the same internal request-input rewrite path.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS rewrites matched prefixes and literal or header authorities' now also selects a route with host_rewrite and path_rewrite and asserts the literal authority and whole-path rewrite.

notes: Format substitution, regex rewrite, path_rewrite_policy, auto_host_rewrite and host_rewrite_path_regex remain explicitly rejected. The wire test from ac04c7ad continues to cover the shared request-input copy path.
